results.title: Urrutia touts progressive support as he looks to move up in 1st District race
results.description: With time running out before the state primary election, progressives in the 1st Congressional District Democratic primary are looking to consolidate around one candidate, and Christian Urrutia is making his pitch.

results.title: Teaching your kids the importance of knowing how to call 911
results.description: Dr. Ali Raja, chief of emergency medicine at Mass General Brigham, said kids should know how to call 911 and that it is important for them to know their address, because they shouldn't always assume someone will know where they are in an emergency.

results.title: US Trump Administration Prepares Mass Visa Revocation Targeting Up To 200,000 Foreigners
results.description: The Trump administration is preparing to revoke up to 200,000 business and tourism visas held by people who have sought asylum in the United States, in what would be the largest mass visa revocation in US history.
